component.name: hanstat
component.summary: Character and word statistics for Chinese, Japanese and Korean books

description.p: hanstat reads .epub and .txt files in Chinese, Japanese and Korean and counts their characters and words: totals, unique and once-only characters and words, coverage, per-section breakdowns and reading time.

It shows how much of a book your Anki cards and vocabulary levels (HSK, TOCFL, JLPT, Korean 1–6급) already cover, keeps a Library of the books analysed, and orders them into a reading path that teaches the words each next book needs.
The word segmenters (LTP, CKIP, Kiwi, SudachiDict) are downloaded on first use.
